# Review workflow

When reviewing any pull request or branch diff, apply [radius-code-review](../skills/radius-code-review/SKILL.md). Invoke the skill when available; otherwise read and follow its file. If you cannot access it, report that limitation rather than claiming the review followed it.

The skill owns review scope, findings, convergence, test-evidence criteria, and the summary contract. Do not duplicate those rules here. This pointer is not a guarantee of hosted skill loading; verify behavior using the skill's hosted-review acceptance procedure.
